title: How Revision Builds Confidence for the 11 Plus Exam?
author: lilymorgan
contentHtml:
As the 11 Plus test comes around, you often see your child stressed, worrying about whether they’ll be able to pass the exam. You know what causes it? Lack of confidence. 

Various resources and methods help children build confidence for the exam, such as effective revision, mock exams, and practice tests. However, the question on the minds of several parents is, How does revision build confidence for the 11 Plus exam? 

This blog contains key insights on how revision builds your child’s confidence for the 11 Plus exam. Keep reading. 

How Revision Builds Confidence for Grammar School Exams?

The following key points explain how revision helps build confidence for the 11 Plus test.

  • Helps Identify and Address Weak Areas

  • Revision helps identify weak areas, and it is essential to identify these areas to boost 11 Plus test scores. 
  • By just cramming and not doing active revision, your child will fail to recognise the loopholes in their 11 Plus paper preparation. 

  • Reinforce Learning

  • Repetitive revision reinforces the learning. Children who have a habit of revision tend to retain the information better.
  • The more the reinforcement, the better prepared your child is for the exam
  • Well-prepared children feel confident about the grammar school exam.

  • Familiarise Your Child with the Exam Format

  • Revision of 11 Plus topics, regular practice through mock exams, familiarises your child with the exam format, which boosts their confidence. 
  • There’s a considerable difference in the 11 Plus scores of children who go to the exam hall well-revised and those who don’t revise, thinking it’s not essential.

  • Teach Time Management 

The timed revision tests teach your child how to allocate time to different questions, so that they complete the real exam right on time.

Effective Revision Materials for the Exam

The following are the effective revision materials for children preparing and revising for the 11 Plus test:

  • Practice Tests
  • Subject-Specific Workbooks
  • Past Papers
  • Mock Exams
  • 11 Plus Summer Revision Course

Note: It's advisable to use a combination of resources for the best grammar school exam revision.

Role of 11 Plus Summer Revision Courses in 11 Plus Revision

Summer is the best time for 11 Plus summer revision because children have no school responsibilities. Most of the 11 Plus tutoring platforms offer a structured 11 Plus summer revision programme for confident exam performance to boost children’s 11 Plus exam scores and help them secure positions in the top grammar schools. 

Feature Benefit
  • Mock Exams
 The summer revision courses conduct regular mock exams, which help children with effective 11 Plus revision.
  • Build Skills
 The highly qualified 11 Plus tutors leading 11 Plus summer revision courses focus on building exam skills and techniques. 
  • Live Small Group Classes
 There are only 5-6 children in one class, which allows tutors to provide personalised revision plans to each child.
  • Immediate Feedback
 Students get immediate results of mock exams, and tutors also provide detailed feedback later on.

 

Strategies for Effective 11 Plus Revision

The following strategies will help your child with effective 11 Plus revision.

  • Create a realistic revision schedule.
  • Use effective revision resources.
  • Practice regularly.
  • Focus on mastering exam techniques.
  • Make 11 Plus revision fun and engaging.

Conclusion 

Revision is crucial for success in the 11 Plus. Revision builds exam confidence, reinforces learning, and helps identify areas for improvement. There are various effective revision tools, including practice tests, mock exams, worksheets, and summer revision courses. You can help your child revise effectively for the 11 Plus paper by assisting them in creating revision schedules, providing them with revision resources, and encouraging them to practice regularly.
